jq -r '.tool_input.command' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eiq '(^|[;&|]) *rm +-[a-z]*r[a-z]*f[a-z]* +(/($| )|~($| )|\*($| )|\.($| ))|(^|[;&|]) *rm +-[a-z]*f[a-z]*r[a-z]* +(/($| )|~($| )|\*($| )|\.($| ))|git +push[^;&|]*(--force\b|-f\b)|git +reset +--hard|git +clean +-[a-z]*f|chmod +-R +777 +/|mkfs\.|dd +[^;&|]*of=/dev/'; then jq -n --arg cmd "$cmd" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:("Blocked risky command: " + $cmd)}}'; else echo '{}'; fi; }
